nameEn: Manufacture of bodies (coachwork) for motor vehicles; manufacture of trailers and semi-trailers
description: This class includes the manufacture of bodies for motor vehicles and the manufacture of trailers and semi-trailers.
includes: manufacture of bodies, including cabs, for motor vehicles
manufacture of trailers and semi-trailers: box trailers, tanker trailers, flatbed trailers
manufacture of caravans and camper vans
manufacture of vehicle body parts: doors, windows, fenders, guards, bumpers, instrument panels
finishing of motor vehicle bodies: painting, trim work
excludes: manufacture of parts and accessories for motor vehicles, see 2930
manufacture of trailers specially designed for the transport of highly radioactive materials, see 2829
